---
title: Maths alt text
format:
  mcanouil-typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: An equation with an alt attribute keeps its alternative text in the Typst output and in the PDF tags.
        check: bash _checks/accessibility.sh math-alt
    mcanouil-typst:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: true
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['alt: "Mass equals energy over the speed of light squared\."']
---

The relation is [$m = E / c^2$]{alt="Mass equals energy over the speed of light squared."} in short.

::: {alt="The sum of one over n squared tends to pi squared over six."}
$$\sum_{n=1}^\infty \frac{1}{n^2} = \frac{\pi^2}{6}$$
:::
